s: Solomon builds Solomon's house
q: in which Solomon had built the LORD’s house and his own house

s: David is a king of Israel
q: the house of David king of Israel

s: David is a man of God
q: for David the man of God had so commanded

s: Solomon offers burnt offerings (on the LORD's altar before the porch)
q: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the LORD’s altar which he had built before the porch

s: Solomon builds LORD's altar (before the porch)
q: the LORD’s altar which he had built before the porch

s: Solomon appoints priests (in divisions to their service, per David's ordinance)
q: He appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests to their service

s: Solomon appoints Levites (to praise and minister before the priests)
q: the Levites to their offices, to praise and to minister before the priests

s: Solomon appoints doorkeepers (by divisions at every gate)
q: the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate

s: LORD's temple is completed completed (from foundation to finish)
q: So the LORD’s house was completed.

s: Ezion Geber located in Edom (on the seashore)
q: Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.

s: Eloth located in Edom (on the seashore)
q: Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.

s: Solomon builds cities built by Solomon (cities given to him by Huram)
q: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon

s: Huram sends Huram's ships and servants (to Solomon, with knowledge of the sea)
q: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea

s: Huram gives cities to Solomon
q: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon

s: Solomon prevails against Hamath Zobah
q: Solomon went to Hamath Zobah, and prevailed against it.

s: Solomon builds Tadmor (in the wilderness)
q: He built Tadmor in the wilderness

s: queen of Sheba is a queen (ruler of Sheba)
q: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon

s: Solomon has successor Rehoboam (his son, reigned in his place)
q: Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

s: Solomon is loved by LORD (God delighted in him and set him on his throne)
q: Blessed be the LORD your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for the LORD your God

s: Solomon owns throne of ivory (Solomon's throne) (overlaid with pure gold)
q: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

s: Solomon owns ships of Tarshish (Solomon's ships) (sailed with Huram's servants)
q: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram’s servants.

s: Solomon owns horses and chariots (Solomon's) (four thousand stalls, twelve thousand horsemen)
q: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen

s: Solomon receives tribute from kings of the earth (every year)
q: They each brought tribute: vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules every year.

s: Solomon receives gold from kings of Arabia (along with governors of the country)
q: All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

s: Solomon imports horses from Egypt (and all lands)
q: They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands.

s: Solomon’s wisdom is given by LORD (God put it in his heart)
q: to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

s: queen of Sheba lives in her own land (returned there after visit)
q: So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

s: Solomon’s wisdom is sought by kings of the earth
q: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom

s: Solomon’s wisdom exceeds fame heard by the queen (half was not told her)
q: half of the greatness of your wisdom wasn’t told me. You exceed the fame that I heard!

s: Solomon’s riches exceeds all the kings of the earth (also in wisdom)
q: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

s: Solomon’s riches includes annual gold six hundred sixty-six talents (per year, besides traders' and merchants' gold)
q: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

s: Solomon’s riches has effect on silver not considered valuable (in Solomon's days)
q: Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.

s: LORD is god of Solomon (called 'the LORD your God')
q: Blessed be the LORD your God, who delighted in you

s: LORD loves Israel (to establish them forever)
q: because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever.

s: LORD has house LORD's temple (in Jerusalem; Solomon's ascent leads to it)
q: his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house

s: queen of Sheba gives queen's gifts (queen of Sheba's gifts) (to King Solomon)
q: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones.

s: Solomon is a king (of Israel)
q: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

s: timber (cedar, cypress, algum) used for terraces and instruments (terraces for the LORD's house and king's house; harps and stringed instruments)
q: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers.

s: Jeroboam has father Nebat
q: concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat

s: Rehoboam is son of Solomon
q: Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

s: Solomon reigns over Israel (ruled from Jerusalem)
q: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

s: Solomon reigns in Jerusalem (forty years)
q: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

s: Solomon reign duration forty years
q: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

s: Solomon rules over kings from the River to the land of the Philistines and the border of Egypt (extent of dominion)
q: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

s: Solomon buried in David's city
q: Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in his father David’s city

s: Solomon father is David
q: he was buried in his father David’s city

s: Jeroboam fled to Egypt (fleeing from Solomon)
q: for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon

s: Israel rebels against David's house (to this day)
q: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.

s: LORD spoke through Ahijah the Shilonite (word to Jeroboam)
q: the LORD might establish his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat

s: Rehoboam has title king
q: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men
